blurb: Guests enjoy a 50 to 60 minute private hot air balloon flight at sunrise, drifting 2 to 5 miles at 3 to 5 mph over red rock formations, the Virgin River, and views of Zion and Snow Canyon. The experience includes preparation, the flight, and a post-flight sparkling cider toast. Flights are private to the guest's party, with up to 6 passengers per basket, subject to weight.
